problem.statement_latex: For uniformly random $A\in\mathbb Z_q^{n\times m}$, output $0\ne z\in\mathbb Z^m$ with $Az=0\pmod q$ and $\|z\|_\infty\le\beta$. Chen--Liu--Zhandry study polynomial prime $q$, fixed constant $c$, $\beta=(q-c)/2$, and sufficiently large polynomial width, including $m=\Omega((q-c)^3 n^{c+1}q\log q)$. Complexity is measured in quantum gates and classical bit operations on the explicit public matrix, including its dimensions and modulus length.
problem.statement_text: For uniformly random $A\in\mathbb Z_q^{n\times m}$, output $0\ne z\in\mathbb Z^m$ with $Az=0\pmod q$ and $\|z\|_\infty\le\beta$. quantum.headline_latex: Polynomial time in the public dimensions and $q$, Chen--Liu--Zhandry quantum filtering.
quantum.details_latex: The guarantee holds for the stated wide random matrix, prime modulus and infinity-norm bound. Quantum filtering succeeds with the prescribed error-support and Fourier-coefficient conditions; preparation and processing of the LWE-like quantum states are included in the polynomial running time. The output is a classical nonzero short kernel vector.

classical.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(m,\log q)$ time in a stronger regime, Kothari--O'Donnell--Wu.
classical.details_latex: The deterministic classical result covers all the Chen--Liu--Zhandry SIS infinity-norm parameter regimes. In particular, for arbitrary input matrices and $m\ge Cn^3$, it finds a nonzero $z$ satisfying $Az=0\pmod q$ and $\|z\|_\infty\le\lfloor q/6\rfloor$. Here $C$ is an appropriate absolute constant. This worst-case wide-matrix result strengthens both the input distribution and the norm guarantee of the matched quantum regime.

evidence.description_latex: Rigorous classical matching and stronger classical parameters. The matrix width and infinity-norm threshold define the algorithmic scope.

hardware.description_latex: The quantum filtering construction uses polynomial logical space in the full public-matrix dimensions, Fourier transforms and coherent filtering. Large instances require fault-tolerant state preparation and arithmetic. The deterministic classical method gives a direct ordinary-hardware implementation for the same regime.
